claims.claim: Registers exa_search for source discovery and instructs Pi to cite URLs and treat returned material as untrusted evidence.
Registers exa_contents for highlights and optional bounded text from known source URLs.
Builds highlights-first search requests after validating known fields and cross-field constraints.
Bounds contents retrieval to validated URLs and optional character, freshness, and live-crawl limits.
Requires configured Exa API credentials for each operation and tracks both configured and trimmed forms as secrets.
Performs one network attempt without automatic retries and rejects redirects.
Redacts configured credential text from parsed response content before validating and returning it.
Truncates model-visible output by line and byte limits, saving complete formatted output only when truncation occurs.
Creates private overflow files with mode 0600 and tracks their temporary directories for cleanup.
Removes tracked output directories on session shutdown.
Applies a final configured-credential scrub before model-visible or private overflow output is emitted.
